analysis.canvasSummary: 1672x941 corporate annual-report infographic in Chinese, organized as a large branded hero panel on the left, KPI and donut-chart modules on the upper right, strategy cards and roadmap across the lower half, a performance chart on the lower right, and a split footer with corporate values and a blue quotation banner.
analysis.backgroundDescription: Diffuse white-to-very-light-blue report background with subtle blue illumination and faint architectural/mesh texture. The background is largely clean whitespace around bounded panels and artwork; the hero landscape, charts, cards, frames, logos, and footer wave are separate foreground modules.
